description: Accumulate a new evidence batch into a growing thesis WITHOUT rewriting history: version bump, appended observations, recomputed confidence, recorded supersessions. This is the snowball step (cf. THESIS.md → THESIS_REFINED.md correction pattern).

outputs.name: thesis_next
outputs.to: thesis vN+1 {version, observations+, confidence, corrections[], supersedes}

params.confidence_rule: mean of member confidences weighted by basis rank (verified-2026=1.0, govt-data=0.9, well-established=0.7, template-analysis=0.5)
